decks.name: Powerful Light
decks.description: A Light Side starter built entirely from The Last Jedi, made to face Powerful Darkness. Rey, Luke and the Resistance fleet show off a wide range of mechanics.

decks.name: Powerful Darkness
decks.description: A Dark Side starter built entirely from The Last Jedi, made to face Powerful Light. Kylo Ren, Snoke and the First Order bring the pressure.

decks.name: Hope
decks.description: A Rogue One Light Side deck for intermediate players, made to face Despair. Jyn, Cassian and the Rebel strike team call in Subordinate support.

decks.name: Despair
decks.description: A Rogue One Dark Side deck for intermediate players, made to face Hope. Krennic, Vader and the Empire's troopers hold the line with Subordinates.

decks.name: Rise Together
decks.description: A Star Wars Rebels Light Side deck from Spark of Rebellion, made to face Divide & Conquer. The Ghost crew launches the Phantom and Phoenix Squadron from its supply.

decks.name: Divide & Conquer
decks.description: A Star Wars Rebels Dark Side deck from Spark of Rebellion, made to face Rise Together. The Inquisitors and the Imperial fleet hunt the rebels.

decks.name: Yuuzhan Vong Intermediate Starter
decks.description: The Yuuzhan Vong arrive with coralskippers, a worldship and Nom Anor. A notch stronger than the other starters, to show the Vong taking the galaxy by surprise.

decks.name: All the Duchess's Men
decks.description: A Jedi, Mandalorian and Clone deck from Battle Lines built around Obi-Wan Kenobi (W) and Duchess Satine Kryze (C). The 501st and fast Mandalorian speeders protect the Duchess while Obi-Wan does the damage.

decks.name: The Emperor's Armada
decks.description: Emperor Palpatine commands a low curve of TIE Pursuit Fighters, Stormtroopers and Mos Eisley muscle that takes all three arenas early. Empire At War and Death Star II (D) then pay for Endor Imperial Legions, Fleets and Vexis to hold them.

credit.source: Galaxy design, built from Dev's Standard VI 1st-place Dark Side deck (Palpatine)

decks.name: Iron Fist
decks.description: No tricks, just the most efficient Dark Side bodies in the game. Hux fetches Kylo Ren, Patrol Squads and Quinn hold the ground and the Character arena, and TIE Daggers, Neutron Star cruisers and four Death Star IIs own space. Empire At War and the Death Star turn every arena it holds into more build points.

credit.source: Galaxy design, built from Dev's Trade Federation (Vintage III 1st) and Emperor Palpatine (Standard VI 1st) Dark Side archive decks

decks.name: Rule of the One Sith
decks.description: Four Darth Krayt (D) and Krayt (F), Vader and Palpatine lead One Sith Troopers and Fury-class fighters, while four Death Star II (D) and Empire At War snowball build points until the Sith Lords own every arena.

credit.source: Galaxy design, built from Dhamon's Standard VII 3rd-place Dark Side deck (One Sith)

decks.name: Trade Federation Juggernaut
decks.description: Nute Gunray's droid army marches with General Grievous: Droidekas, Super Battle Droid Battalions and Trade Federation Control Cores on the ground, Separatist Starfighter Squadrons, Death Star II and Endor Imperial Fleets in space. Corrupt Senators and Empire At War pay for it all.

credit.source: Galaxy design, built from Dev's Vintage III 1st-place Dark Side deck (Trade Federation) and Dev's The Clone Wars 1st-place Dark Side deck (Grievous)

decks.name: Kenobi's Legacy
decks.description: Obi-Wan Kenobi in every version, with the Republic and Rebel Heroes and Free Gungans holding the ground and CF9 Crossfire Squadrons and Luke's X-wings over them. Gungan Council, Luke's X-wings and Gamorrean Commander call in Subordinates, and Empire At War turns every arena it holds into build points.

credit.source: Galaxy design, built from Dev's Standard VI 1st-place Light Side deck (KZTKgl)

decks.name: Rebel Alliance Command
decks.description: Luke, Leia and Han stack into the Skywalker Twins, Solo Family and Rebel Heroes while Hera's Ghost crew, Ackbar and four Rebel Control Teams hold the ground. Partisan U-wings, Braha'tok Gunships and Phoenix Squadron fill the sky early.

credit.source: Galaxy design, built from the Standard VII 3rd-place Light Side deck, with VictoryOfEagles' Standard VI 2nd-place Light Side deck

decks.name: The Skywalker Saga
decks.description: Luke, Mara Jade and their family, with Anakin and the Antilles and Horn pilots. Jedi Peacekeepers and Snowspeeders hold the ground, Delta Six starfighters and Luke's X-wings hold space, and Prophecy Fulfilled clears their damage every turn.

credit.source: Galaxy design, built from Mitch C's Columns III "Luke & Family" deck (GXY_COL3_Luke_&_Fam)

decks.name: Yoda's Clone Wars
decks.description: Every version of Yoda leads the Clone Wars: Jedi Peacekeepers, Domino Squad and Clone Trooper Legions hold the ground while Delta Six, Azure Angel and Anakin's starfighters hold space. Sympathetic Delegations and Pirate Swoops pay for it, and Swoop Race lets its fast units strike first.

credit.source: Galaxy design, built from Dev's The Clone Wars 1st-place Light Side deck
